name: Tanakpur–Nepal Border Highway
facts: Runs from Tanakpur, in the Kumaon foothills, to the Nepal border.
Bhimdatta, on the Nepalese side, is also known as Mahendranagar.
It is one of the main road crossings into far-western Nepal.
The Sharda river, which the road follows, forms part of the India–Nepal boundary here.
significance: A short national highway link running from Tanakpur in Uttarakhand to the Nepal border at Bhimdatta (Mahendranagar). It is one of the crossings between the Kumaon foothills and far-western Nepal, and it carries the cross-border trade and traffic of that corner of the frontier.
travelNotes: A short road, but the border crossing at the end has customs and immigration formalities — allow time for them.

sources.title: NHAI — National Highways Authority of India
